services.desc: The St. Johns is a bass fisherman’s dream. Big ol’ largemouths lurk in the deep holes, and the crappie bite stays strong in cooler months. Toss a topwater at sunrise near Lake George, or slow-roll a worm around the docks in Astor. Either way, you’re bound to hook into something. Ponce Inlet is where you go when you wanna fill the freezer. Grab a spotlight and a gig, and hit the shallow sand flats once the sun dips. Flounder lay up in the mud waiting to be spotted. And if you’re fishing by day, the jetties are loaded with redfish, snook, and even the occasional tarpon. Oak Hill ain't just another fishing hole-it’s the place to be when the shrimp are running.
